note: THE CONTROL for the two spellings that already work: an ESCAPED `\\$', a bracketed `[$]', and a bare `$' against the empty subject. Both sides answer (0 0 0). They are the reason the divergence beside them is about CONTEXT and not about the character: kg can already match a literal dollar when the pattern says so explicitly, and can already anchor at the end of the subject. What it cannot do is decide between the two from position alone.
